SCHEDULE “B” – URBAN SERVICE DESCRIPTIONS AND RATES (AMENDED BY BL, 3619, 2024; 3649, 2025)
A1: Residential Rate Urban (2026)
Service Description
• Applicable to Urban Customers
• Applicable to residential or domestic use
Rate Description
Energy Charge
Billing Period: Bi-Monthly Basic Charge: $21.29 per Period
All kWh per Period: $0.1379 per kWh
Demand Charge First 20 kW: nil
Each additional kW greater than 20 kW per Period is $9.66 per kW
Minimum Charge The minimum charge per period shall be $21.29

rates_page_html:
Electric Rates Effective January 1, 2026


A1: Residential Rate Urban

  • Period: Bi-Monthly
  • Basic Charge: $21.29 per period
  • Energy Charge: $0.1379/kWh

A3: Residential Rate Rural

  • Period: Bi-Monthly
  • Basic Charge: $25.01 per period
  • Energy Charge: $0.1620/kWh

B1: Small Commercial Rate Urban

  • Period: Bi-Monthly
  • Basic Charge: $48.76 per period
  • Energy Charge: $0.1572/kWh

B4: Small Commercial Rate Rural

  • Period: Bi-Monthly
  • Basic Charge: $59.06 per period
  • Energy Charge: $0.1902/kWh

For more information, please contact Nelson Hydro Administration at (250) 352-8240 or nelsonhydro@nelson.ca.

2026 Hydro Services Bylaw

View the full set of the interim approved 2026 and 2027 electrical rates in Schedules B and C of the Hydro Services Bylaw
